name: click
on: any data-act click that has no sound of its own
about: Any button pressed: a small firm click, like a bakelite switch. The commonest sound in the game, so it is short and soft.

name: ui_primary
on: the brass button of a screen: act dodeclare, doraid, doair, dosplit, govappoint, an attack confirmed. Not END THE MONTH, which has month_ask and month_end
about: The one brass button of a screen pressed (END THE MONTH, Attack, Send): a heavier click with brass in it, and its release.

name: ui_dial
on: act gchist, gclevel, gcdepth: a dial moved one stop
about: A dial moved one stop (the history dial, the difficulty, a volume): the small sharp click of a detent.

name: ui_back
on: act unpick, wreckno, govkeep; any Cancel, or a step back to the screen before. Not the close stud or Esc: those are card_close and screen_close
about: Close, cancel, step back: the same click, lower and softer, so that going back sounds like going back.

name: ui_tab
on: act tab, lens, menu, tradeall, ledgerall, monthall
about: A tab chosen: a card flicked forward in an index.

name: switch_on
on: a setting turned on: act fog, setask (on), watchpref, auto (on)
about: A setting turned on, the lamp lit, night to day: a heavy toggle thrown over.

name: switch_off
on: a setting turned off: the same acts, off
about: A setting turned off, the lamp put out, day to night: the toggle thrown back, a shade lower.

name: ui_error
on: an order the rules refuse (the function returns false or a reason)
about: That cannot be done: two dull knocks on the desk. Never a buzzer.

name: ui_notify
on: one thing that wants the player now and is not an alert slip (an offer on the telephone, a question from the cabinet)
about: Something wants attention: one touch on a desk bell.

name: alert_slip
on: a new alert appears in the alert strip (once for a batch)
about: An alert slip arrives: a telegraph sounder rattles out three strokes. Dry and short, so that several alerts in a month do not nag.

name: card_open
on: openModal for a small card: town, unit, fallen, award, shell, raid planner steps
about: A card laid on the table: it slides in and lands. For every card that opens (an army's, a town's, a report).

name: card_close
on: openModal(null) when a card was open: act close, the close stud, Esc, a click outside the card
about: A card taken up again: the same slide, backwards and lighter.

name: screen_open
on: openModal for a page: ledger, books, staffs, cabinet, trade, tech, level
about: A whole room of the game opened (the arsenal, research, diplomacy, the ledger): a deep drawer pulled out and a book set down.

name: screen_close
on: that page closed
about: That room closed: the book shut and the drawer pushed home.

name: page_turn
on: moving from one report to the next; a page of the ledger or the guide
about: A page of a heavy book turned: for the ledger, the roll of honour, the guide, and moving from one report to the next.

name: stamp
on: the WON stamp lands; an order that cannot be undone: doraid, doshell, govdecree
about: An order confirmed, and the WON stamp: a rubber stamp brought down firmly on paper. The sound of "it is done". Fire it as the stamp lands, not as it starts to fall.

name: stamp_low
on: the LOST stamp lands
about: The LOST stamp: the same stamp as "stamp", lower and heavier, so that good and bad are told apart before the word is read.

name: stamp_light
on: something bought or ordered in the arsenal or a city: an arsenal order, act job. Not a move on the map
about: Something bought or ordered: the same stamp, lightly, as a clerk marks a chit. For the everyday order; "stamp" is for the ones that matter.

name: pickup
on: act pick, pickall, fleet, airfleet, wing (something taken in hand)
about: A piece lifted off the table: an army or a fleet taken in the hand. (The 3D game already calls this name; it has been silent until now.)

name: putdown
on: act standmonth, joinarmy, joinall, gotmarch (the piece set down)
about: A piece set down on the table: wood on wood, and it settles.

name: order_march
on: march() when the player orders a move by road
about: An order to march drawn on the map: one stroke of a wax pencil.

name: order_attack
on: act attack, storm, sally, probe (an attack ordered)
about: An attack ordered: two hard strokes of the red pencil, an arrowhead, and the pencil rapped on the map.

name: order_cancel
on: act stopmarch, stopjob, cancelbuild, sendback
about: An order taken back: the mark rubbed out.

name: select_region
on: selectRegion() from a click on the map
about: A province chosen on the map: a fingertip on paper.

name: coin_run
on: the treasury figure counts
about: The treasury figure counts to its new value: one short run of coins, done inside the 400 ms the figure takes.

name: coins
on: act cash, drafts: money raised by the player's own order
about: Money spent: a few coins counted down onto the desk.

name: pen_sign
on: a technology goes into work; act tradesign, govpromise: a treaty or a promise signed
about: A paper signed: a steel nib across it and a full stop. For treaties, pacts, promotions, a save made.

name: radio
on: act spygo, spymission; an intelligence report opened
about: A wireless message through the static: dots and dashes (they spell the game's initials). For intelligence, spies, a ship's report.

name: month_ask
on: openModal({kind: "askend"})
about: The question before the month ends ("armies at the front have no orders"): a clock's single soft chime, and two ticks. A pause, not an alarm.

name: month_end
on: nextMonth() when the month really ends
about: The month is ended: the calendar page torn off, the day book shut, one stroke of the clock. Played once when END THE MONTH is pressed.

name: month_passing_loop
on: runOthers() starts it; it stops the moment month_yours plays
about: The other countries moving, very fast: a clock running quick and a teleprinter chattering somewhere. Goes round under the playback of everyone else's month.

name: month_yours
on: arrive(): the month is the player's again
about: The others have moved and the month is yours: two notes, like a hand on the shoulder. Never loud.

name: month_card_open
on: openModal({kind: "news"}) with a month card
about: The month's report laid before you: a dispatch case unlatched and the card drawn out onto the table.

name: month_card_good
on: 0.6 s after month_card_open, when the card has more good rows than bad
about: The month went your way: two soft rising chords, a light touch of the bell. Under the month card when the news is good.

name: month_card_bad
on: the same, more bad than good
about: The month went against you: two chords that sink, low strings, a muffled stroke. Under the month card when the news is bad.

name: month_card_quiet
on: the same, even or nearly empty
about: A month in which nothing was settled: one held chord, neither up nor down. Under the month card when the news is mixed or thin.

name: note_arrives
on: a staff note appears
about: A staff note arrives: a slip of paper slid onto the desk and a knuckle's tap to say "read me". For each lesson of the first hour.

name: note_done
on: a staff note is stamped DONE: played as the stamp lands
about: A staff note stamped DONE: the stamp, and a small bright touch of the desk bell after it. The stamp alone is "stamp".

name: note_closing
on: the closing note appears
about: The last staff note of the first hour ("the command is yours"): the command figure, gently, with a bell on its last note. Heard once in a player's life.

name: campaign_start
on: newGame() from the opening screen (act start)
about: You take command: a kettledrum roll and the whole command figure from the full band. For the moment a country and a year are chosen.

name: drums
on: openModal({kind: "attack"}): the two sides drawn up
about: The two sides are drawn up: a roll on the side drum and four strokes, the bass drum under them. Before a battle is joined.

name: victory
on: a battle report opens and the player won; a town taken
about: A battle won, a town taken: the last three notes of the command figure, rising, with the band under them. Short, because it is heard often.

name: defeat
on: a battle report opens and the player lost; a town fallen
about: A battle lost, a town fallen: the same three notes turned down instead of up, low brass and strings, a muffled drum.

name: war_declared
on: act dodeclare; any declaration of war in the month card
about: War is declared: a kettledrum roll that swells, a dark chord from the low brass, and one heavy stroke. For you, on you, or between two others.

name: treaty_signed
on: an alliance, a peace or a pact made
about: A treaty signed, an alliance made, a peace: two warm chords from the brass and a bell. Calm after "war_declared".

name: city_taken
on: a capital or prize city taken by the player
about: A great city is yours: three tower bells and the rising figure over them. For a capital or a prize city, not for every town.

name: city_lost
on: a capital or prize city lost by the player
about: A great city is lost: one bell tolls twice, low strings under it.

name: nation_falls
on: a country is eliminated (the announcement)
about: A country is beaten and leaves the war: the command figure broken off and falling, muffled drums, a last low note.

name: nation_freed
on: a country is liberated (the announcement)
about: A country is set free and comes back into the war: bells from every tower and the figure whole again.

name: alert
on: openModal({kind: "invade"}) or "landing" against the player; followAlert for an urgent alert
about: Something needs you now (a landing on your shore, an attack on you, a government in danger): two quick notes and a drum tap.

name: research_done
on: research finished, in the month card
about: The workshops have something new: three small bells climbing, like a good idea arriving.

name: medal
on: openModal({kind: "award"}); act appoint, promote
about: A medal pinned on, a general promoted: a ruffle on the drum and two bright notes.

name: drum_low
on: a red band appears, when the moment has no call of its own
about: A red band crosses the screen (war, a country that may fall): one low drum stroke in the hall. When the moment has its own call ("war_declared", "nation_falls"), play the call and not this.

name: unit_lost
on: openModal({kind: "fallen"}); a division or a named ship lost
about: A division is destroyed, a ship goes down with her name: one muffled stroke and a low note falling.

name: world_won
on: openModal({kind: "worldwon"})
about: The campaign is won: the whole of our march, four bars, drums and all. Heard once, at the very end.

name: campaign_lost
on: the campaign is lost
about: The campaign is lost: the figure once more, slow and in the dark, the drum with a cloth on it, and silence after.

name: marching
on: march() by road, after order_march (0.3 s later)
about: Infantry steps off: eight paces of a column on a road, boots together and the rattle of kit. Played when infantry is picked up or ordered to march.

name: rail_move
on: a move by rail ordered (ui.rail is on when the move is made)
about: For the browser game when an army is sent by rail: the whistle and the engine pulling away. Set against "marching", it is how a rail move and a march are told apart with the eyes shut.

name: ship_horn
on: act shipto, sail, toport, fleetgo: a fleet or a convoy sails
about: A big ship's horn: deep, slow to speak, carrying over the water. Played when a fleet is picked up, sails or changes its orders.

name: ship_guns
on: openModal({kind: "seareport"})
about: A salvo from a turret of heavy guns: three reports close together and the long roll back across the water.

name: shore_bombardment
on: act doshell; openModal({kind: "shorereport"})
about: A fleet shells the coast: the salvo, the shells rumbling away overhead, and the bursts inland a few seconds later.

name: torpedo_hit
on: a ship torpedoed, in a sea report
about: A torpedo strikes: a blow against the hull, a column of water, and plates ringing.

name: ship_sinking
on: a capital ship sunk, in a sea report
about: A ship goes down: her plates groan, the sea pours in, air and steam come roaring up, and she is gone. Played with the picture of a ship sinking.

name: landing_craft
on: act doland; openModal({kind: "landing"})
about: Troops go ashore: the craft's engines, the surf, the ramp chains running and the ramp down on the beach. For a landing ordered and a landing made.

name: raid_day_heavy
on: openModal({kind: "raid"}) or "airreport" for a raid flown by day (mission bomb, strike, ground, line, fleet, harbour, town) by a country whose bomber has four engines
about: For the raid card (and the browser game) when the raid was flown by day by four-engined bombers, with their deep steady drone: the bombers, a fighter going through, flak, the bombs. No siren, no lamps, no fire after.

name: raid_day_medium
on: the same by day, for a country whose bomber has two engines
about: For the raid card (and the browser game) when the raid was flown by day by twin-engined bombers, with their slow uneven beat: the bombers, a fighter going through, flak, the bombs. No siren, no lamps, no fire after.

name: raid_night_heavy
on: a raid flown by night (mission night) by a country whose bomber has four engines
about: For the raid card (and the browser game) when the raid was flown by night by four-engined bombers, with their deep steady drone: the siren, a lamp struck, the bombers, flak, the bombs, and fire after.

name: raid_night_medium
on: the same by night, for a country whose bomber has two engines
about: For the raid card (and the browser game) when the raid was flown by night by twin-engined bombers, with their slow uneven beat: the siren, a lamp struck, the bombers, flak, the bombs, and fire after.

name: siren
on: a raid on one of the player's own towns, in the month card
about: The same warning, shorter, under the name the 3D game already calls.

name: fighter_pass
on: act doair for a patrol, an escort, a scouting flight; mission superiority
about: The same as fighter_pass_01, under the name the 3D game already calls.

name: parachutes
on: airborne troops dropped
about: Airborne troops go out over their target: a transport overhead and the canopies cracking open one after another.

name: artillery_salvo_01
on: act bombline, dosiege; openModal({kind: "siege"})
about: The whole gun line fires, gun after gun down the line in a second or two. For a bombardment ordered, or a battle opened by an army with artillery.

name: battle
on: a battle report opens (before victory or defeat)
about: A fight heard from a little way off, five seconds of it: rifles, machine guns, shells bursting, a tank gun. Played once when a battle is resolved.

name: bridge_blown
on: act blow, wreck
about: A bridge is blown: the charges go, the span groans and drops into the river.

name: rail_cut
on: act cutrail
about: A railway is cut: the charge or the bomb, rails wrenched and ringing, ballast coming down.

name: rail_mended
on: rails mended, in the month card
about: A line is open again: the last spikes driven home and an engine's whistle to try the road.

name: fire_start
on: act burnorder, scorch
about: Something is set alight: the whoosh as it catches and the first crackle. For the order to burn stores, bridges or a town's works before a retreat.

name: dig_in
on: act fortify, garrison
about: An army digs in: shovels going into earth, a pick, spoil thrown on the parapet. For the order to fortify or to hold.

name: build_works
on: works finished, in the month card; act job
about: A building going up: a saw, hammering on timber, a winch's ratchet. For a town building ordered or finished.

name: room_day_loop
on: from the first click to the end, very quietly: the war room
about: The war room by day: the air of a big panelled room, the wall clock, somebody typing two rooms away. Heard when the camera is high above the map, and under every card.
